name: external_bobbuilder_ac
description: Native external multifeature cheat with upstream defaults (godmode, infinite ammo, aimbot and ESP enabled; noRecoil disabled). Measures a compound read/write workload. Operator-driven; keep defaults fixed across replicates.

extra.operator_commands: After runner prints the AC PID and the local bot match is active, launch External_Cheats\AC\AssaultCubeExternalBobBuilder\Release\AssaultCubeAimbot.exe. Keep upstream defaults: godmode, infinite ammo, aimbot and ESP ON; noRecoil OFF. Use the aimbot activation key as documented upstream consistently. Verify health/ammo effects; observe for 30 seconds, close the external tool, then press Enter in the capture shell. Keep AC alive through cooldown.
extra.notes: Compound native read/write workload, not a pure health-freeze case. Defaults already enable several modifications at startup, so toggling them off after launch would contaminate a claimed single-feature trace. See evaluation-plan.md.
